candidateReferences.relevance: INAF identifies a Nihon Kiin lecture by Michael Redmond 9p about sacrifice in a Dosaku–Yasui Santetsu game. This verifies the topic and players, not the precise move numbers.

candidateReferences.kind: Secondary candidate-selection lead, not positive ground truth
candidateReferences.relevance: Connects the lecture to 1669-09-16 and also discusses sacrifice in the 1668-07-10 Chitetsu game. Exact positions still require replay and independent evidence.
Root and move ownership are predictions. Therefore an ownership flip alone does not establish sacrifice intent, and a healthy-root requirement can miss an already-foreseen sacrifice.
